source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Inspect the bridge visually.
3. Document the overall condition of the structure.
4. Identify and detail structural components.
5. Take detailed photographs.
6. Document any visible damage or deterioration.
7. Detail any suspected hidden damage.
8. Describe the level of severity of each defect.
9. Note the potential impact on structural integrity.
10. Document conditions leading to defects.
11. Identify areas requiring immediate attention.
12. Recommend inspection techniques or methods for hidden defects.
13. Suggest repairs and prioritize them.
14. Document missed inspections or deferred maintenance.
15. Provide estimates for required repairs and maintenance.
16. Make recommendations for future inspections.
17. Offer a comprehensive summary of findings.
18. Ensure report is clearly organized and readable.
19. Provide supporting sketches, diagrams or maps.
20. Review the report for consistency and accuracy.
21. Include your name, title, and contact information.
22. Submit the report to the appropriate authorities.
